defects.description: The check rejects only when recent requests exceed the limit, so limit + 1 requests are allowed inside one window.

trigger.input: const l = createLimiter({limit:3, windowMs:1000, now:() => 1000}); [1,2,3,4].map(() => l.allow('user:a'))

defects.why_missed: The suite stops below the limit or reads remaining(), which computes limit minus count and is correct; only the (limit+1)-th call reaches the wrong comparison.
defects.severity_rationale: The request exactly one above the limit is silently accepted at a supported boundary.
defects.failure_condition: const l = createLimiter({limit:3, windowMs:1000, now:() => 1000}); [1,2,3,4].map(() => l.allow('user:a')) -> [true,true,true,true]

detection_criteria.mechanism: The check rejects only when recent requests exceed the limit, so limit + 1 requests are allowed inside one window.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.

defects.description: Only user identifiers are lowercased, so token identifiers that differ by case get separate budgets.

trigger.input: const l = createLimiter({limit:1, windowMs:1000, now:() => 1000}); l.allow('token:ABC'); l.allow('token:ABC'); l.allow('token:abc')
trigger.note: two prior hits so the off-by-one defect alone cannot make the third call pass; this trigger isolates the normalization defect

defects.why_missed: The case-insensitivity test only uses user identifiers, the one kind the normalizer handles; the token kind is never exercised with mixed case.
defects.severity_rationale: A mixed-case token identifier bypasses its existing budget on the supported case-normalization edge.
defects.failure_condition: const l = createLimiter({limit:1, windowMs:1000, now:() => 1000}); l.allow('token:ABC'); l.allow('token:ABC'); l.allow('token:abc') -> true

detection_criteria.mechanism: Only user identifiers are lowercased, so token identifiers that differ by case get separate budgets.
detection_criteria.proof: Show one input or state where the output contradicts expected_behavior.
